backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining Course, PDFResource, SupportMessage, and FAQ types with CRUD operations for each, using Map and List collections and a migration hook for schema upgrades.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts old actor state (with text-based category fields) to new actor state (with typed Category variant enum) by mapping text strings to variant values.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features (branding updates, category changes, new subjects) with associated file paths, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated text file containing 1–2 sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the frontend codebase structure.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with the page title set to 'Odisha Exam - Video Materials and PDFs' and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with public routes (Home, Courses, Video, About, Contact) and admin routes (/admin/login, /admin, /admin/pdfs, /admin/videos), all wrapped in AdminAuthProvider.
frontend/src/components/AdminLayout.tsx: Provides a protected admin layout wrapper with a sticky header, navigation links (Dashboard, PDFs, Videos), and logout functionality, redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, social media links, quick navigation links, subject categories, and a copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Simple page layout wrapper that composes Navbar, main content area, and Footer into a full-height flex column.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Responsive top navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, active-link highlighting, an Admin link, and a 'Start Learning' CTA button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Provides a React context and hook for simple hardcoded-credential admin authentication, persisting session state in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing identity, login/clear functions, and login status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for all backend data operations including fetching/mutating courses, FAQs, support messages, and PDFs via the ICP actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts (Merriweather, Inter), sets up Tailwind directives, and defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes including colors, sidebar tokens, and reusable component classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider for React Query and InternetIdentityProvider for ICP authentication wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Static About page displaying the platform's mission, core values, team members, and historical milestones with a hero section and structured layout components.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard page displaying stats (PDF and course counts) and navigation cards linking to PDF and video management sections.
Admin login page with a username/password form that authenticates via useAdminAuth and redirects to the admin dashboard on success.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminPDFsPage.t: Admin page for managing PDF resources, providing a form to add new PDFs (with category selection) and a list view with delete functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminVideosPage: Admin page for managing video courses, providing a form to add new courses (with YouTube/external URL, category, and instructor) and displaying existing courses.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page with a support message submission form and an FAQ accordion that falls back to default FAQs if none are returned from the backend via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CoursesPage.tsx: Course catalog page with category filter buttons and a search input that fetches all courses via React Query and renders filtered course cards with skeleton loading states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section, platform features, subject category grid, and featured courses fetched from the backend, targeting Odisha competitive exam preparation.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayerPage.tsx: Video player page that loads a single course by ID, renders its video content and metadata, and displays a sidebar of related courses from the same category with skeleton loading states.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, typography/serif fonts, border radii, box shadows, and animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the 'Odisha Exam' educational platform project, including schema version, architectural notes, known issues, and a list of implemented features such as subject structure, site naming, and UI changes.
